title: Chapter 6409: Everyone Should Have A Chance

Chapter 6409: Everyone Should Have A Chance

Chapter 6409: Everyone Should Have A Chance

“Young Noble, can this light truly help me?” She looked down at the light.

“Of course.” He took another sip.

“It can help me hide, but its mysteries..” She paused.

Her talent and dao comprehension were excellent. However, she couldn’t find other uses for this light outside of its connection with Soaring Peak.

Given her mighty cultivation, she began to think there was nothing more to the light.

“Because your dao heart is still not firm enough.” He said: “After cleansing Eternal Abyss, I left behind this light so it would never fall again.”

“!!!” She became frozen since she had read of this legend before.

Although only a few remarks described this unverifiable legend, he spoke of it so casually.

“Young Noble, you are...” She recalled a taboo existence - a true immortal from the ancient ages.

He only smiled and gazed into the distance.

“I apologize for my ignorance, unaware of your presence, Immortal...” She prostrated.

He raised his hand and said: “Now you know, it’s fine.”

Her mind was overwhelmed since he was more than the supreme ancestor of Desolate Frontier. If this was true, he surpassed anyone else currently...

“So do you think you have grasped it?” He stared at her.

Her hand trembled as she held the light, realizing it exceeded her imagination.

“How foolish I am, to grasp this light yet unable to wield its potential.” She said emotionally.

Suddenly, something warmth manifested in her heart. As for a heaven-slayer, her mind should have been tough.

Unfortunately, due to her circumstances, she lived in anxiety and fear. After all, she had no control over her fate. Now, this strand of light gave her hope. Optimism and life returned to her eyes as she held her head high.

“My dao heart was weak indeed since I was still helpless as a heaven-slayer.” She said with embarrassment.

However, she couldn’t be faulted due to her situation. She overcame countless obstacles and reached an incredible realm only to be subservient to those stronger. Furthermore, she didn’t accept this and struggled to escape Trinity Kingdom.

“It’s not your fault, it’s normal to be shaken by despair. But, helpless or not, resilience is required or you will be your downfall.” He said.

“I understand.” She took a deep breath and said: “I must be resolute or all of my sufferings would have been in vain.”

“It’s a transformation.” He nodded: “When you have enough courage to take this step, you must continue while working on your dao heart.”

“I will not let you down.” She bowed.

“Don’t worry about me.” He pointed at the light in her hand and said: “It picked you, no one else. This shows how much you yearned for life and your perseverance earned its approval, so don’t let it down.”

“I will try.” She looked down at the light - the key to unlocking her fate but she didn’t realize it then.

He smiled and enjoyed the scenery.

“Young Noble, may I accompany you during your trip throughout the isles?” She asked.

Was the immortal just passing by? Then he wouldn’t have stuck around. Was he here to kill the villains? Not quite either since he could have obliterated everything.

Even the first-ranked villain, Heavenly Crane, wouldn’t be able to block a single move.

“Everyone should have a chance.” He knew what she was thinking and responded.

“I see.” She stood there in ponderance.

“But this region shouldn’t be around any longer.” He took another sip and said.

“You want to put an end to Isles of Evil?” She asked.

“It formed on its own volition.” He said.

“Yes, we don’t truly understand it.” She responded: “Immortal-seek Peak should be the core and the isles follow it.”
